title: Four useful participant roles
source:
@startuml
actor Customer
participant "Checkout API" as API
database Orders
queue "Order events" as Events
Customer -> API: place order
API -> Orders: save
API -> Events: publish
@enduml

title: Call, self-action, and reply
source:
@startuml
participant Client
participant API
Client -> API: request
API -> API: validate
API --> Client: result
@enduml

title: Asynchronous send
source:
@startuml
participant API
queue Events
participant Worker
API ->> Events: publish order
Events ->> Worker: deliver order
Worker --> Events: acknowledged
@enduml

title: Alternative outcomes
source:
@startuml
participant User
participant API
User -> API: place order
alt Inventory available
  API --> User: confirmed
else Sold out
  API --> User: unavailable
end
@enduml

title: Repeated interaction
source:
@startuml
participant Client
participant API
loop Each chunk
  Client -> API: send chunk
  API --> Client: next
end
@enduml

title: Parallel branches
source:
@startuml
participant API
participant Warehouse
participant Payments
par Reserve inventory
  API -> Warehouse: reserve
else Charge payment
  API -> Payments: charge
end
@enduml

title: Critical region
source:
@startuml
participant Session
database TokenStore
critical Rotate atomically
  Session -> TokenStore: consume old token
  Session -> TokenStore: issue replacement
end
@enduml

title: Optional path
source:
@startuml
participant API
participant Mailer
opt Receipt requested
  API -> Mailer: send receipt
end
@enduml

title: Meaningful time gap
source:
@startuml
participant Client
participant API
Client -> API: start job
... up to 30 seconds later ...
API --> Client: completed
@enduml

title: PlantUML participant shape zoo
source:
@startuml
actor User
boundary Gateway
control Coordinator
entity Order
database Store
queue Events
collections Results
User -> Gateway: submit
Gateway -> Coordinator: handle
Coordinator -> Order: update
Coordinator -> Store: persist
Coordinator -> Events: publish
Coordinator -> Results: append
@enduml

title: Explicit activation bars
source:
@startuml
participant Client
participant API
database Store
Client -> API: request
activate API
API -> Store: query
Store --> API: row
API --> Client: result
deactivate API
@enduml

title: Diagram note
source:
@startuml
participant API
database Store
API -> Store: commit
note over API, Store: Runs in one transaction
Store --> API: durable
@enduml

title: Participant lifecycle
source:
@startuml
participant API
create Worker
API -> Worker: start job
Worker --> API: completed
destroy Worker
@enduml

title: Special break fragment
source:
@startuml
participant Sensor
participant Monitor
participant Runner
loop Each cycle
  Sensor -> Monitor: metrics
  break Threshold exceeded
    Monitor -> Runner: stop run
  end
end
@enduml

title: Reference and source numbering
source:
@startuml
autonumber
participant Client
participant API
Client -> API: begin checkout
ref over Client, API: OAuth login
API --> Client: ready
@enduml
